items.label: Ergonomic Comfort Design
items.value: Features a 105° curved arc that aligns with the body's natural posture. Cushions are filled with 5.9-inch thick, high-resilience foam for firm yet gentle support, reducing fatigue and ensuring lasting comfort during extended sitting

items.label: Durable & Stable Aluminum Frame
items.value: Constructed with a corrosion-resistant aluminum frame and a robust U-shaped leg base. This design provides exceptional stability, prevents sagging and warping, and offers far greater longevity compared to plastic or wooden frames

items.label: Spacious & Breathable Seating
items.value: Each seat measures 23.6" x 27.6", offering ample room to relax. The high-resilience Textilene mesh fabric promotes excellent airflow, supports significant weight, and keeps you cool and comfortable

items.label: Realistic Wood-Grain Finish with Weather Resistance
items.value: Arms and tabletop feature a high-definition wood-grain texture (HDPS material) that mimics the look of real wood. This fade-proof, easy-to-clean material is weather-resistant and requires no maintenance, retaining its beauty for years

items.label: Easy Assembly & Reliable Support
items.value: Designed for quick, tool-free setup with clear instructions. For safer shipping, your order may arrive in multiple boxes over different days. Backed by 24/7 customer service to ensure your complete satisfaction
